response.text:
Proposed 30-minute product review (brainstorming) — next week

0:00–0:05 — Welcome & objective (5 min)
- Quick purpose: align on current performance, surface top risks, and identify 1–2 decisions needed.
- Confirm meeting scope and desired outcomes.

0:05–0:20 — Metrics deep-dive (15 min)
- Key metrics to review (each: current value, recent trend, variance vs. target)
  - Primary success metric(s)
  - Top supporting metrics (engagement, retention, conversion, revenue, cost as relevant)
- Recent signals and anomalies (positive/negative)
- Data quality / gaps and confidence level
- Hypotheses for observed changes

0:20–0:26 — Risks & mitigations (6 min)
- Top 3–5 product or operational risks tied to metrics (impact × likelihood)
- Short-term mitigation options and resource implications
- Known unknowns that need investigation

0:26–0:30 — Decisions & next steps (4 min)
- List specific decisions requested (e.g., continue experiment, re-prioritize roadmap item, allocate X resources)
- For each decision: decision owner, deadline, required follow-up info
- Confirm immediate actions and owners for follow-ups

Pre-meeting checklist / prep (send with invite or attach to notes)
- Latest dashboard or snapshot of the metrics called out above
- One-page summary of recent experiments/changes
- Brief risk register or top incidents since last review

Suggested attendees (optional)
- Product manager (owner)
- Data/analytics lead
- Engineering lead
- Design or UX lead (if relevant)
- Ops/Support representative (if operational risk present)

Desired outcome
- Clear alignment on health of the product, prioritized risks to address, and 1–2 concrete decisions with owners and timelines.
